results.title: Mocha - the fun, simple, flexible JavaScript test framework
results.snippet: Mocha is a feature-rich JavaScript test framework running on Node.js, making asynchronous testing simple and fun. Minimal core, extensible.

results.title: mocha - npm
results.snippet: Mocha has around 8M weekly downloads. One of the oldest and most established Node.js test frameworks.

results.title: mochajs/mocha: simple, flexible, fun javascript test framework - GitHub
results.snippet: Mocha.js test framework for Node.js. 22k GitHub stars. Requires external assertion libraries like Chai or Node assert.

results.title: Setting up Mocha and Chai in 2024
results.snippet: Mocha has no built-in assertion library or mocking — you need to pair it with Chai, Sinon, etc. Startup is fast (~300ms) but setup is verbose.
